sample_user_facing_cards.title: Heel slides
sample_user_facing_cards.purpose: Gently explore comfortable knee movement while keeping the front of the thigh calm.
sample_user_facing_cards.setup: Lie or sit in a comfortable position with the heel able to slide.
instructions: Slide the heel only through a comfortable range.
Stop before the front of the thigh feels guarded or sharp.
common_mistakes: Moving quickly to chase more motion.
sample_user_facing_cards.safety_note: This card is not a test and does not decide readiness.

sample_user_facing_cards.title: Quad set
sample_user_facing_cards.purpose: Practice a gentle thigh muscle squeeze without changing position much.
sample_user_facing_cards.setup: Rest with the leg supported and the knee comfortable.
instructions: Gently tighten the front of the thigh.
Keep the rest of the leg relaxed.
Ease off if the area feels protective or sharp.
common_mistakes: Pressing harder because the exercise feels simple.
Treating the squeeze as a strength test.
sample_user_facing_cards.safety_note: This card is not dosage, progression, or clearance.

sample_user_facing_cards.title: Short-arc knee extension
sample_user_facing_cards.purpose: Practice controlled knee extension in a small comfortable range.
sample_user_facing_cards.setup: Support the knee in the setup documented by the future clinician-facing plan.
instructions: Straighten the knee only through the planned comfortable range.
sample_user_facing_cards.safety_note: This card is not a strength test and not a progression gate.
